'''Eolus City''' is the capital of the [[Socialist Republic of Aurendale]] in the extracted source material.

The Aurendale source describes Eolus City as powered by wind, solar, and nuclear energy. This draft preserves that as a source claim while leaving the exact infrastructure, date, and 1994 status open for review.

== Canon Limits ==

Do not assign Eolus City a founding date, population, districts, mayor, or detailed power grid until stronger source material is reviewed.
